stories.title: Define Explainability Schema and Validation Models
stories.description: Create Pydantic models defining the explainability contract (source, meaning, limitations) and enforce validation within tool models to ensure consistent structure across all evaluation signals.

stories.title: Render Explainability Metadata in Chat UI
stories.description: Update MessageBubble and related frontend components to display explainability fields (source, meaning, limitations) in a readable format within chat responses.

stories.title: Integrate Explainability Across Provider and Trial Flows
stories.description: Ensure explainability metadata is consistently included for both provider (EVAL-F1, EVAL-F2) and clinical trial (EVAL-F3) flows within EvaluateCareFacade orchestration paths.

stories.title: Implement Unit and Integration Tests for Explainability Layer
stories.description: Add backend unit tests for mapping logic and schema validation, plus integration tests validating end-to-end inclusion of explainability metadata in API responses and chat outputs.
